I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` to `data/2025-12.csv` and committed it as `afcaa3a` with the message `2025-12: add rows`.

`scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit. It only checks that each row has the same number of fields as the header. It reads the year from `scripts/check.conf`, and I didn't look at that file, so I can't say whether the check covered the 2025 files.

I left `inbox/2025-12.csv` in place, since you asked me to add the file, not move it.
